title: Quarter Tethered Deployment Rhythm and OKR Cascade for Private/VPC/on-prem
creator: Aisha Thompson
description: Runbook and plan for a quarterly cadence that aligns Private/VPC/on-prem engineering work, PM priorities, and OKR/initiative tracking. The aim is to create a repeatable 'tethered rhythm' where feature tranches, compatibility verification, tenant activation windows, and upgrade waves are coordinated across Product, Engineering, Design, and Customer Success. This ticket captures the MVP playbook, acceptance criteria, dependency map, and a draft stakeholder communication plan.
decisions: Adopt a 10-week quarter model with a 2-week hard freeze for compatibility testing at the end of the quarter
Group customers into three activation cohorts (Pilot, Ramp, Tranche) by risk profile and region
Require a compatibility sign-off from infra and runtime teams for each private build before customer-facing rollout
Use feature flags to dark-launch changes and a standardized rollback window of 48 hours for all waves
tradeoffs: Shorter rollout windows speed customer value delivery but increase operational load on ops and SRE teams
Conservative compatibility gates reduce incidents at activation but delay releases for lower-risk customers
Allocating more engineering effort to test automation upfront increases Q1 cost but reduces per-tenant manual validation later
acceptance_criteria: Quarter plan document published to Confluence with tranche definitions and calendar
Activation cohort list finalized and exported to CSV for RTS and Success teams
Compatibility test harness (infra + runtime + networking smoke tests) running in CI and passing against a representative private image
Stakeholder review completed with sign-offs from: Runtime Eng, Infra, Security, Customer Success, and Legal (when required)
Communication templates for pilot, ramp, and full waves available in Drive and reviewed by PM and CS
tasks: Draft quarter calendar with freeze and fallback windows (PM)
Define cohort selection criteria and assemble seed list (CS + AM)
Run a compatibility matrix for top 10 customer configurations (Eng)
Create and baseline telemetry dashboards for activation signal (Console + Observability)
Author rollback and emergency cutover runbooks (SRE + Eng)
Write release notes and migration guidance for customers (Docs)
Schedule cross-functional dry run for the first pilot wave two weeks before activation (All teams)
stakeholders: Legal & Security: Priya Shah (compliance review as needed)
